NOTE
**Still not ready: the description is still messy and there are leftover CI commits**

New: The author took part in the CZO thread, and Daniel K said the PR extends the filters from #24200 and isn't blocked on the design discussion. There was no new push. Missing: the description still has an empty "Fixes:" line and a malformed "Fixes #<36878>" that won't link the issue, and the two "ci:" retry commits are still there.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't add "maintainer review" yet; @karlstolley, who gave the feedback, can re-check once the description and commits are cleaned up.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for joining the CZO discussion, and good to hear Daniel K sees this as an extension of #24200. Before review, please fix the "Fixes: #36878" line in the description and squash away the two "ci:" retry commits, following the [guide on making PRs reviewable](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html). Please leave the labels to us.
```
